body: Are you using `screen/immersive_mode` in the export_presets.cfg or are you using [DisplayServer.window_set_mode()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-method-window-set-mode)?

> Are you using `screen/immersive_mode` in the export_presets.cfg or are you using [DisplayServer.window_set_mode()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-method-window-set-mode)?

I have an enabled "immersive mode" in export settings, that's all.

Please provide an MRP to make this easier to test and fix:
- A small Godot project which reproduces the issue, with no unnecessary files included. Be sure to not include the `.godot` folder in the archive (but keep `project.godot`).
- Having an MRP is very important for contributors to be able to reproduce the bug in the same way that you are experiencing it. When testing a potential fix for the issue, contributors will use the MRP to validate that the fix is working as intended.
- Drag and drop a ZIP archive to upload it (max 10 MB). **Do not select another field until the project is done uploading.**
- **Note for C# users:** If your issue is *not* C#-specific, please upload a minimal reproduction project written in GDScript. This will make it easier for contributors to reproduce the issue locally as not everyone has a .NET setup available. 

We would need to know the details of your game setup, specific settings etc.

I think we are talking about if the game is displayed fullscreen (immersive) or not. | Immersive | Non-Immersive (notice the clock and tray) | |-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | ![Immersive](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a8cf99b-75e8-443d-aaa8-bf8142a1310f) | ![Non-Immersive](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a50c50bb-a47d-4da8-971f-0b91ed2c7c34) | I have tested remote deploy export of the MRP on Godot 4.5-beta3 on **Linux** and i **DO NOT** see the reported issue. What is interesting about how this works, is that immersive setting is converted to a command line flag in [platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp#L3097) - these flags are saved to a file called [`_cl_`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp#L3661) which is packaged into the assets. Godot outputs the values of these params for us to see - you can see the **--fullscreen** in the output below when did the remote deploy export of the MRP This `_cl_` file is then read by the code which runs on the device [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/platform/android/java/lib/src/org/godotengine/godot/GodotActivity.kt#L78) and applied to the running game in the Kotlin [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/platform/android/java/lib/src/org/godotengine/godot/Godot.kt#L259) @DNAGamesGit - do you see the "--fullscreen" in the output when you export the MRP through remote deploy?
